They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What's more, she lifts a five kilogram dumbbell every morning before work.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The experience taught Lily more than any book could. Lily bought a dress online because it was much cheaper. Also, she is a very honest person.

Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The gym looked quieter than usual that evening. On Monday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. For example, the government decided to nationalize the struggling railway company.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Grace and Lily are preparing a report about the gym. Lily's dream job is to be a cook. In fact, I want a cup of coffee.
The dining hall has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
